response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep exposure to TypeScript, cloud infrastructure (AWS), and agentic workflows via MCP, with notable open-source contributions and technical leadership — but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years in production-grade AI systems, vector databases, RAG architectures, or direct GenAI customer-facing consulting, which are core to the role.
strengths: Proven experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
Extensive cloud and distributed systems background (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices)
Strong technical leadership through mentoring, workshops, and open-source project ownership
concerns: No clear documentation of 8+ years focused on production AI/GenAI systems
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architecture implementation
Limited evidence of direct enterprise customer-facing technical leadership in GenAI consulting
